title: Sex and Style
author: Jessica Reis Posner
description: Jessica Reis Posner is the entrepreneur and creator behind Sex and Style, a podcast, blog, and brand blending fashion, intimacy, and wellness to inspire women everywhere. Join us as we dive into honest conversations about reclaiming confidence, nurturing relationships, and celebrating personal style. Whether it's navigating motherhood, spicing up your love life, or finding the perfect outfit, we're here to support you on your journey. Tune in for expert tips, candid stories, and a vibrant community dedicated to helping you feel your best inside and out.
